installation-smoke.scope: Installed npm tarball, isolated in-process Broker (no LaunchAgent changes), temporary Chrome-for-Testing profile and Native Messaging registration, actual DSH ToolRuntime with default plugin approval mode. Deterministic tool calls; no LLM, daily user profile or business account.
passed: Installed tarball uses an isolated personal Broker; repeated install preserves path and authentication without touching the user service

limitations: Deterministic tool calls, no model planning or Codex performance comparison.
No daily Chrome profile, live user Broker service or business-account validation.
Default two-minute lifetime is tested; multi-hour stability and interruption latency percentiles are not measured.
Packed installation used an isolated in-process Broker and real Native Messaging; the separate native smoke used an independent restricted Broker CLI process.
